test_pathfinder_load_save: test that a PathFinder can load a navmesh file and save it back with identical settings
test_shortest_path_geodesic: test that ShortestPath computes geodesic distance between two navigable points in a scene
test_multi_goal_shortest_path: test that MultiGoalShortestPath finds the geodesically closest goal from a list of endpoints
test_navmesh_islands: test navmesh island queries including island count, area, radius, and per-island random point sampling
test_greedy_geodesic_follower: test that GreedyGeodesicFollower resolves action keys and returns a sequence of actions ending with stop
